title: Data Quality & Deduplication
description: A focused, advanced path on the quality and deduplication patterns that separate a reliable Pandas pipeline from a brittle one: cross-table entity linking, multi-step dedup, and debugging subtle data-integrity failures.
outcomes: You'll deduplicate with correct key choice, link entities across multiple DataFrames without fan-out, catch silent Pandas bugs that corrupt running totals, and apply vectorised approaches where apply() would be too slow.
